stories.title: More than 6,500 fly-tipping cases left open on Flintshire Council’s system, audit finds
stories.summary: More than 6,500 fly-tipping cases have been left open on Flintshire County Council’s system, an internal audit has found. Auditors said the council’s customer records system, known as CRM, logs reports rather than individual fly-tips, so one pile of dumped waste can be recorded several times. stories.title: Health board says there are “no quick or easy solutions” to Wrexham Maelor parking
stories.summary: Parking at Wrexham Maelor Hospital has reached “crisis point and is no longer sustainable”, according to Wrexham Council’s deputy leader. stories.title: Man jailed for three years after driving stolen taxi the wrong way on the A55
stories.summary: A man who stole a taxi in Holyhead, seriously injured a cyclist and then drove the wrong way along the A55 has been jailed for three years. Darragh O’Grady, 31, was sentenced at Caernarfon Crown Court today, Tuesday 10 November.
